## Import



CFW cluster firewall bypass config can be imported using the composite ID.

For VPC_FW type, the format is `{fw_type}#{ccn_id}`:

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cfw/clusterFwBypassConfig:ClusterFwBypassConfig example VPC_FW#ccn-p3mlp0tj
```

For NAT_FW type, the format is `{fw_type}#{nat_ins_id},{ccn_id}`:

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Cfw/clusterFwBypassConfig:ClusterFwBypassConfig example NAT_FW#nat-h1i1mf4n,ccn-p3mlp0tj
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
